title: the model is credited only with what it saved
line: a task's outcome is judged on the files that came into downloads/ while its launcher ran: a page of the step saved earlier by hand and still in the folder is collected and attached as a hand's save, and the run names it as not the model's, its outcome what the model did (nothing); a task during which two files came in says it produced two, with their names

steps.say: John Young Davidson's memorial saved earlier by hand into downloads/, not yet collected
the memorial's task answered by a captured launcher result reporting not_saved, and nothing comes in while it runs

has: no page came into the folder
collect also took findagrave-memorial-143847338.html, in the folder before the task: not the model's

expect.why: the page in the folder before the task is no page of the model's: the task saved nothing
the hand's page is still collected and attached, as any page saved by hand is

steps.say: her Kentucky death records search's task: the captured result says not_saved, and two pages come in while it runs, the search with its key and another memorial

expect.why: the step's own page is judged; the run says the task brought in two files, naming both
